JVNDB-2026-029751
Multiple vulnerabilities in Yamaha VOCALOID6 Editor
Overview
VOCALOID6 Editor provided by Yamaha Corporation contains multiple vulnerabilities listed below.
Use of hard-coded credentials (CWE-798) - CVE-2026-76131
Missing authentication for critical function (CWE-306) - CVE-2026-76137
Zero reported these vulnerabilities to JPCERT/CC.
JPCERT/CC coordinated with the developer.

Affected Products
Yamaha Corporation
VOCALOID6 Editor versions 6.13.1 and earlier
Impact
An attacker may impersonate a legitimate VOCALOID6 Editor and gain access to Yamaha's activation and content servers (CVE-2026-76131).
Any process running under the same local user account as a running VOCALOID6 Editor instance may escalate privileges via a local named pipe (CVE-2026-76137).
Solution
[Update the Software]
Update the software to the latest version according to the information provided by the developer.
